_comment: Per-reel visual variety. A reel's `style` field picks one of each; without it, the reel number rotates through them (theme n%6, motion n%3). Music defaults to "none": reels are silent (no music, no sound effects) — a deliberate choice for this page. Read by src/brand/theme.tsx, scripts/style.mjs and scripts/synth-audio.py.

none.label: Silent — no music or sound effects
